title: adiantum nelumboides
intro: Adiantum nelumboides, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Adiantum nelumboides include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
